# Synchronous embedding call may cause latency

The embedder.embed([query]) call is performed synchronously inside the request path; a slow embedding operation will block the search function and any caller relying on it.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/retrieval/search.py` — `knowledge_compiler.retrieval.search.search`
